product_metadata.title: Bits and Pieces - Iridescent Glass Butterfly Fountain Sculpture – Indoor Home Décor - Zen Water Fountain - Desk or Tabletop Accessories - 12" Tall
features: Butterfly Statue: Constructed with various diverse materials, including sculptural resin composites, glass bowls, and metal flowers and leaves, our iridescent table fountain creates a soothing accent for any home or office.

Water Sculpture: This ethereal indoor fountain features a whisper quiet, electric recirculating pump from which water cascades down into the bottom pool, where it is returned to the top of the fountain.
Garden Decor: Add a bit of elegance and charm to your space with our glass sculpture. This house ornament is a visual and audible delight that is bound to leave your friends and family in awe.

Spiritual Decor: This home decor accessory instantly relaxes and restores your senses, whilst adding a sense of peace and tranquility to your environment. It can be used on any tabletop, bedroom, living room, or office table decoration.
Size Details: Our unique and gorgeous glass butterfly sculpture is the perfect gift for nature lovers to reconnect with the outdoors even while inside. This mesmerizing sculpture stands 12” tall.
